messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Customers cannot easily track garage progress visibility without manually calling each supplier.
  quote: We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
- problem: The system lacks built‑in visibility of garage progress, forcing the team to interrupt work with phone calls.
  quote: we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
- problem: The platform does not automatically send claim progress messages via SMS and email.
  quote: we really need claim progress messages to go out via SMS and email to policyholders automatically.
- problem: Handlers cannot see live repair progress, forcing them to call garages for updates.
  quote: our handlers are spending half their day calling garages because we can’t see live repair progress in the system.
- problem: Handlers are manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, causing delays.
  quote: we’ve got some ... handlers ... manually ... moving garage ... estimates out of ... correlation ... and it ... causing ... delays
- problem: The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration for the team.
  quote: our team’s daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages
- problem: The user cannot see when tasks are stuck or when letters are not acknowledged by policyholders.
  quote: we’re missing visibility when tasks get stuck or letters go unacknowledged by policyholders
- problem: The claim progress notification feature is not yet live, preventing automatic updates to policyholders.
  quote: We’re still waiting on those claim progress messages to go live — the team’s keen to get policyholders auto-notified at key stages.
